name: AI Sales & Marketing Automation

seo.title: AI Sales and Marketing Automation | VipraTech
seo.description: AI agents that qualify leads, follow up on WhatsApp and email, update your CRM and personalise outreach, built around your sales process.

hero.headline: Follow up on every lead, in minutes, without adding headcount
hero.subheadline: We build agents that qualify leads, follow up across WhatsApp, voice and email, and keep your CRM current, within the consent and messaging rules you operate under.

intro: Most lost deals are lost to slow or inconsistent follow-up, not to price. We automate the repetitive parts of your funnel, research, first response, qualification, reminders and CRM updates, and route warm conversations to your team with context. Messaging respects opt-ins and platform rules.
what_we_build: Account research and personalised outreach drafts
how_we_work: Map your funnel and where leads stall
Launch on one segment with A/B comparison

faqs.q: Which CRMs do you work with?
faqs.a: Common ones include Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho and LeadSquared, plus custom CRMs through their APIs.
We use opt-ins, frequency caps and stop words, and hand conversations to people as soon as there is real interest or a complaint.

faqs.q: How do we know it works?
faqs.a: Each launch runs against a control group, so you can compare response, conversion and time to first contact.
